Hero.subtitle: Born from authentic Arabian craft, our fragrances carry the weight of history with a presence made for today.

Story.title: A craft passed through generations
Story.body: GABR was born from a deep passion for Arabian perfumery. Every ingredient is sourced with care from the world's finest origins, left to mature until it reaches its full character — fragrances that belong to no one else.

NotesStory.title: Layers of Feeling
NotesStory.body: Every GABR fragrance is built on three harmonious layers, unfolding in turn to tell their own story on your skin.

top.label: Top Notes
top.desc: The first impression — light and bright, fading within minutes to open the way for the heart

heart.label: Heart Notes
heart.desc: The true character of the fragrance, emerging after the opening and lingering for hours

base.label: Base Notes
base.desc: The final signature — deep and warm, staying on the skin long into the evening

Newsletter.title: Be the first to know
Newsletter.body: Subscribe for news on limited releases and the stories behind our fragrances.

Footer.about: GABR Perfumes — a contemporary Arabian fragrance house, shaping heritage craft in a modern voice.

About.title: Where Heritage Meets the Present
About.intro: GABR is not just a fragrance house — it's a journey that begins deep in the Arabian desert and ends on your skin.
About.paragraph1: GABR was founded by a family steeped in the craft of perfumery, passing down the secrets of distillation and aging through generations. Every bottle carries decades of expertise and an obsession with detail.
About.paragraph2: We travel to the world's finest sources — Cambodian oud, Taif rose, Indian Ocean amber — selecting only what is worthy of the GABR name.
About.paragraph3: Today, we offer that legacy in a contemporary voice, for a generation seeking authenticity without giving up modernity.
About.value1Body: Every fragrance is hand-composed under the guidance of perfumers with over two decades of expertise.
About.value2Body: We import the finest raw materials from their original sources around the world.
About.value3Body: High concentrations give our fragrances a presence that lasts from morning to evening.
About.quote: A fragrance is not just a scent — it's a memory we craft to last.
